row.name: MetLife Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=39 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.34 tightness=0.84 base_volume_vs_leg=0.76 base_volume_vs_avg=0.87
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 39 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 0.5% vs its 20-SMA, -0.8% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: The mechanical grade is A but two recorded defects weigh heavily: VOL is a hard FAIL because the 39-session base triggers the catalyst-volume requirement and volume came in at only 1.31x the 50-session average against the 1.5x threshold, and C is PARTIAL because the base at 39 sessions is nearly double Bonde's 3–20 session window. The chart confirms the base is visually extended and choppy across the shaded region from early August through early October, with multiple overlapping bars and no clear tightening, and the tightness proxy of 0.84 sits well above the A+ ceiling of 0.70.
claude.key_risk: A 39-session loose base with sub-threshold volume on the burst day means there is no institutional conviction behind the move and the wide consolidation range leaves plenty of overhead supply to absorb any follow-through.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal-day high near 99 or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior close of 94.43.
